finding: A generated proof flag, invented verifier name, 64-character fake receipt hash and fake checkpoint identifier could earn verified_gain credit in initial commit 9566da1.
remaining_trust_boundary: Callback supplied by an independent evaluator must inspect real proof traces, source and checkpoint hashes and actual verifier runtime identity. A hostile caller supplying a fake callback remains outside the local scorer's authentication capability.
repair: verified_gain now requires evaluator-only trusted_proof_check callback and strict frozen hash validation; transfer_score similarly requires trusted_execution_check. Without callbacks, candidate self-report earns zero transfer and zero verified new capability.
